title: New Developer
author: No-Suit-9997
selftext:
Hey all,

I’m new to game creation. I have background in LUA Coding for FiveM. Mainly HUD/UI things and inventory items. I decided to take a crack at making my own game.

One thing I’m struggling with is making a model for my main character as well as any other human like NPC for my game. Do you guys have any tips/suggestions?

comments.author: Opelmannator
comments.body: I have been using metahuman for peoples. It is not ai but easy use.

replies.author: No-Suit-9997
replies.body: Can you drop a link for me?

comments.author: Ill-Past4609
comments.body: Are you doing 3D? Or 2D ? But their are so many tools for 3d honestly I haven’t dabbled in the 3d game space I’m having trouble with 2d as it is can only imagine 3d

comments.author: Nilo_Team
comments.body:
hey-

for humanoid characters without full blender, nilo.io is free in browser- generate the character, auto-rig on a T-pose biped, knock polys with the LOD slider, export GLB/FBX

won't do quadrupeds/creatures yet but for main char + human NPCs it's solid

LMK :)
